name: Droogmakerij de Beemster (Beemster Polder)
description: North of Amsterdam in North Holland, the Beemster was a large lake until windmills pumped it dry between 1609 and 1612, making it the Netherlands' first polder reclaimed from a lake. Today you can cycle across its flat, geometric grid of straight roads, canals and farmland, laid out with Renaissance ideals of order and still largely as the 17th-century planners designed it.
